reason: EXACT_BLOCKER: a previously unused verified official public no-login Gateshead Metropolitan Borough Council / Planning Data listed-building-outline window was processed as a four-record canonical-binding cohort. Entities 42118318, 42118441, 42118409 and 42118258 are all BUILDING_PRESENT with authoritative MultiPolygon geometry, Open Government Licence v3.0 and data date 2023-08-17. All four records have canonical_parcel_id=null, parcel_status=UNPROCESSED and local_spatial_join_required=true, and none exposes an exact official DEM/LIDAR tile selector attributable to height_difference_2. Local OpenCode must publish a non-null slot-bound canonical_parcel_id with BUILDING_PRESENT plus parcel geometry/bbox or an exact official DEM/LIDAR tile selector before source acceptance.
required_binding: parcel geometry/bbox or exact official DEM/LIDAR tile selector
